networkAccess.reasoning: Two opt-in uses, both triggered only by an explicit user action: (1) Fetching image bytes for references dragged from a browser tab — tries the source domain directly first, falls back to images.weserv.nl (a free image CORS proxy) when the source blocks cross-origin reads. (2) Optional BYOK call to api.openai.com for auto-tagging, only when the user supplies their own key in settings.
